run-12 YS-04 / fingerprint 8168c808. UNCHANGED at e935a05. The on-chain getStakersRange is half-open [start,end) (StableStaker.sol:666-678, NatSpec line 663 explicit). observations: vault bump 0110ce4 CONFIRMED: ERC4626YieldStrategy._acquireShares now credits vault.convertToAssets(sharesReceived) (line 115), was previewRedeem at ad12cb1. The deploy + PhusdMinterRepoint scripts resolve to this fixed build via @vault/. This addresses the run-12 YS-01 intent-conformance note (doc prescribed convertToAssets; previous build used previewRedeem).

YS-04 STILL LIVE but partially self-defending: gather writes JSON .count = allStakers.length (the UNDERCOUNT from the buggy paging), and forge leg1 preflight requires dolaCount(JSON) == stakerCount(DOLA on-chain). If even one staker is dropped, JSON .count < on-chain count and the preflight REVERTS (`stale ... staker count - re-run gather`). So the bug manifests as a hard preflight DoS / re-run loop rather than silent staker loss — but with a single page (count <= PAGE_SIZE=200) the boundary still drops the LAST staker (end clamps, last index never fetched), so for any non-empty pool the preflight reverts. script-auditor should re-confirm severity given this gating (DoS not value-loss).
